headline: OJK Sanctions 1,011 Capital Market Violators, Hunts New Perpetrators Every 2 Weeks
summary: Indonesia's financial services regulator OJK has imposed sanctions on 1,011 capital market violators, with a total value of Rp2.582 trillion. It said enforcement will be strengthened.
why: The OJK (Otoritas Jasa Keuangan) is Indonesia's financial services regulator, overseeing capital markets, banks and non-bank financial institutions. Its enforcement actions shape market conduct and investor confidence.
original_headline: OJK Sanksi 1.011 Pelanggar Pasar Modal, Buru Pelaku Baru Tiap 2 Pekan
